about.title: A simple way to sort out the draw before playing
about.description: Kora was born for those matches where nobody wants to waste ten minutes splitting up players. Pick the number of teams, load the list, and let the app do the work fast, clearly, and without hassle.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.items.free.question: Is Kora free to use?
faq.items.free.answer: Yes, Kora is 100% free. You don't need to pay anything or create an account to build your teams.
faq.items.edit.question: Can I edit the teams after the draw?
faq.items.edit.answer: Yes. Before confirming the result you can switch to manual mode and rearrange players between teams by dragging them.
faq.items.maxPlayers.question: How many players can I add?
faq.items.maxPlayers.answer: It depends on how many teams and players per team you choose: up to 6 teams, with up to 11 players each.
faq.items.share.question: How do I share the teams?
faq.items.share.answer: Once the draw is confirmed, you download an image ready to share on WhatsApp or wherever you like.
faq.items.choose.question: Can I choose the number of teams and players?
faq.items.choose.answer: Yes, you decide how many teams to build and how many players each one will have before drawing.
faq.items.account.question: Do I need to create an account to use Kora?
faq.items.account.answer: No. You can use Kora without registering.

terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern the use of Kora (the "Platform"), an app designed to organize draws and build amateur soccer teams. By creating an account or using the Platform, you accept these terms in full. If you disagree, you should not use Kora.
terms.section1.title: 1. What Kora is
terms.section1.body: Kora lets you upload player lists, set the number of teams, draw or build lineups, and export the result. It's an organization tool, not an official competition service or a betting platform.
terms.section2.title: 2. Registration and account
terms.section2.body: To use some features you need to create an account with real information (first name, last name, email). You're responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity that occurs under your account. Let us know if you suspect unauthorized use.
terms.section3.title: 3. Acceptable use
terms.section3.body: You may not use Kora to upload offensive or illegal content, or content that infringes third-party rights, attempt unauthorized access to other accounts, or interfere with the Platform's normal operation.
terms.section4.title: 4. Intellectual property
terms.section4.body: The design, code, and Kora brand belong to its developers. The data you upload (player names, team configurations) remains yours; you grant us permission to store and process it solely to provide the service.
terms.section5.title: 5. Service availability
terms.section5.body: We do our best to keep Kora available and working properly, but there may be interruptions due to maintenance, updates, or causes beyond our control. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.
terms.section6.title: 6. Limitation of liability
terms.section6.body: Kora is provided "as is." To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use of the Platform, including loss of data or draw configurations.
terms.section7.title: 7. Changes to these terms
terms.section7.body: We may update these Terms in the future. If the change is significant, we'll notify you by email or through a notice on the Platform before it takes effect.
terms.section8.title: 8. Contact
terms.section8.body: If you have questions about these Terms, write to us through the contact channels listed in the "About Kora" section.
privacy.intro: At Kora we take the privacy of your data seriously. This policy explains what information we collect when you use the Platform, what we use it for, and what choices you have.
privacy.section1.title: 1. What data we collect
privacy.section1.body: When you register we store your first name, last name, email, and, if you provide it, your phone number. We also store the data you enter to build draws (player names, number of teams, saved configurations).
privacy.section2.title: 2. What we use it for
privacy.section2.body: We use your data to create and maintain your account, let you sign in, provide support when you need it, and improve how the Platform works.
privacy.section3.title: 3. Marketing communications
privacy.section3.body: We'll only send you news, tips, or promotions from Kora by email if you checked the marketing opt-in box when registering. You can withdraw your consent at any time from your account or by clicking "unsubscribe" on any of those emails, without it affecting your access to the Platform.
privacy.section4.title: 4. Who we share your data with
privacy.section4.body: We don't sell your data to third parties. We only share it with providers necessary to operate the service (for example, sending transactional emails), under confidentiality agreements.
privacy.section5.title: 5. How long we keep it
privacy.section5.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete it, we erase or anonymize your information within a reasonable timeframe, unless the law requires us to keep something specific.
privacy.section6.title: 6. Your rights
privacy.section6.body: You can ask us to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You can also request that we stop processing it for marketing purposes without losing access to your account.
privacy.section7.title: 7. Changes to this policy
privacy.section7.body: If we update this policy in a significant way, we'll notify you by email or through a notice on the Platform.
privacy.section8.title: 8. Contact
privacy.section8.body: For any questions about your personal data, write to us through the contact channels listed in the "About Kora" section.
